_about: Public-domain John Abernethy (1680-1740), Presbyterian minister of Antrim and Dublin and leader of the Irish non-subscribers, for the Word Hoard: Discourses concerning the Being and Perfections of God, Sermons on Various Subjects, Scarce and Valuable Tracts and Sermons, Persecution Contrary to Christianity, and his sermons and pamphlets of 1714 to 1735. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-24 by lane A, round 137 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
